rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for judging someone, something, or an amount too highly.

example.english: We must not overestimate this team's strength.
example.traditional: 我哋唔可以高估呢隊對手嘅實力。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 m4 ho2 ji5 gou1 gu2 ni1 deoi6 deoi3 sau2 ge3 sat6 lik6

rows.note: Use this colloquial expression especially when you estimated a quantity or number too high.

example.english: I overestimate the number of people when buying groceries, so I buy too much food.
example.traditional: 我買餸嗰陣估多咗人數，買咗太多菜。
example.jyutping: ngo5 maai5 sung3 go2 zan6 gu2 do1 zo2 jan4 sou3 maai5 zo2 taai3 do1 coi3
